links.description: Link-only tiles: consoles with no OIDC. Renders an Authentik application with no provider, client secret or redirect URI.

path.description: Appended to the launch URL. Empty opens the host root.

description.description: One line on the tile. It should say what sign-in the console will ask for, because the tile grants nothing.

group.description: Heading the tile sits under on the portal.

access.description: Who sees the tile: admin (admin group only) or users (user group and admin group).

forwardAuth.description: Consoles with no sign-in of their own, behind Authentik's embedded outpost (TM-0425). Each needs its route turned on in the layer that serves it too.

capabilities.description: Named functional capabilities: one switch per functional story, spanning whatever components it takes across whichever layers they live in. CLOSED, unlike `global`: nothing upstream reads this block, so an unrecognised name here is always a typo, and an ignored typo means a capability you thought you declined is still on. See docs/administration/capabilities.md.

module.description: A module name from the blackbox exporter's own config.

consoles.description: Subdomain under global.internalDomain -> probe it or not.

databaseBackup.description: Nightly pg_dump of the bundled Authentik Postgres to the shipped object store; seven-weekday rotation. Rendered only while authentik.postgresql.enabled is true (TM-0788).

identity.description: Objects this chart renders for Authentik's own state: its database on CloudNativePG (TM-0788).

enabled.description: On: this chart renders a CNPG Cluster and Authentik connects to it. Off: Authentik uses the bundled server or one of your own. Default on for a fresh install from 0.9.0 (TM-0788).

name.description: CNPG Cluster name. Authentik's host must resolve to <name>-rw.

owner.description: Database owner role. Must equal authentik.authentik.postgresql.user and the username key in the referenced Secret.

secretName.description: kubernetes.io/basic-auth Secret holding the owner's username and password; the password equals AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD.

storage.description: A bare number here is bytes, which is never what anyone means.

resources.description: Requests and limits for the postgres container, rendered as the CNPG Cluster's spec.resources. Changing it restarts the database at instances: 1.

recovery.description: Bootstrap the cluster from an ObjectStore backup (bootstrap.recovery) instead of an empty initdb. Default off.

upgrade.description: The pre-sync guard that refuses to start Authentik on an empty CNPG cluster while the bundled server's volume is still in the namespace.

bundledDataMigrated.description: True once the bundled server's data has been copied into this cluster, or deliberately discarded. Turns the guard off.

enabled.description: Unset follows capabilities.dataProtection (on); true or false overrides.

unbackedAlert.description: Render TockmoxIdentityDatabaseUnbacked while backups are off.

serverName.description: Name this cluster archives under in the object store. Empty keeps CNPG's default, the cluster name.

restoreDrill.description: Weekly scheduled restore drill: bootstraps a new cluster from the object store, verifies Authentik's user table came back, records PASS/FAIL in the tockmox-restore-drill-register ConfigMap, tears down.

schedule.description: Five-field Kubernetes cron, unlike the six-field CNPG backup schedule.
